# Headless firmware build (no IDE), used by CI and for SIL/HIL.
# It compiles the same files CubeIDE compiles:
#   nucleo_led/Core, nucleo_led/Drivers  (generated by CubeMX)
#   nucleo_led/App                       (our code)
#
#   cmake -B build-fw -G Ninja -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/arm-none-eabi.cmake
#   cmake --build build-fw
# Output: build-fw/led_seq.elf, .bin, .hex
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(led_seq C ASM)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Debug)
endif()
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "-Og -g3")

set(CUBE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/nucleo_led)
# CONFIGURE_DEPENDS: re-scan the folders on every build, so a new .c file
# is picked up without re-running cmake by hand.

file(GLOB APP_SRC CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CUBE}/App/*.c)
file(GLOB CORE_SRC CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CUBE}/Core/Src/*.c)
file(GLOB STARTUP CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CUBE}/Core/Startup/startup_stm32f446*.s)
file(GLOB HAL_SRC CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CUBE}/Drivers/STM32F4xx_HAL_Driver/Src/*.c)
list(FILTER HAL_SRC EXCLUDE REGEX ".*_template\\.c$")   # examples, not real code
file(GLOB LINKER CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CUBE}/STM32F446*_FLASH.ld)

if(NOT STARTUP OR NOT LINKER OR NOT CORE_SRC)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "nucleo_led/ has no CubeMX code yet. Generate it first (docs/GUIDE.md, part 2).")
endif()

add_executable(led_seq.elf ${APP_SRC} ${CORE_SRC} ${STARTUP} ${HAL_SRC})

target_compile_definitions(led_seq.elf PRIVATE USE_HAL_DRIVER STM32F446xx)
target_include_directories(led_seq.elf PRIVATE
  ${CUBE}/App
  ${CUBE}/Core/Inc
  ${CUBE}/Drivers/STM32F4xx_HAL_Driver/Inc
  ${CUBE}/Drivers/CMSIS/Device/ST/STM32F4xx/Include
  ${CUBE}/Drivers/CMSIS/Include)
target_compile_options(led_seq.elf PRIVATE -Wall)
# Our own code must be warning-free; HAL is ST's code, we don't touch it.
set_source_files_properties(${APP_SRC} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wextra;-Werror")
target_link_options(led_seq.elf PRIVATE -T${LINKER}
  -Wl,-Map=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/led_seq.map -Wl,--print-memory-usage)

add_custom_command(TARGET led_seq.elf POST_BUILD
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O binary led_seq.elf led_seq.bin
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O ihex   led_seq.elf led_seq.hex
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_SIZE} led_seq.elf)
